user.title: Connect to OpenWA
user.description: Enter the address of your OpenWA gateway and an API key with the OPERATOR role.

data_description.url: For example http://192.168.1.10:2785. A pasted Swagger URL (…/api/docs) is fine.
data_description.api_key: Starts with owa_k1_. Create it in the OpenWA dashboard with the OPERATOR role.

session.title: Select the WhatsApp session
session.description: Choose the session to send from. Sessions not ready: {not_ready}. A session that is not ready can be added, but messages fail until it is connected in the OpenWA dashboard.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the OpenWA API key
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {name} was rejected. Enter a new key with the OPERATOR role.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure OpenWA
reconfigure.description: Leave the API key empty to keep the current one.

error.invalid_api_key_format: The API key must look like owa_k1_ followed by 64 hex characters.
error.no_sessions: No WhatsApp sessions are visible to this API key. Create one in the OpenWA dashboard first.

abort.wrong_session: A different session belongs in a separate entry. Add it as a new integration instead.

invalid_auth.message: The OpenWA API key was rejected. Re-authenticate the integration.

session_not_found.message: The OpenWA session no longer exists.

forbidden.message: OpenWA refused the request (check the key has the OPERATOR role and access to this chat): {detail}

media_rejected_too_large.message: The media file is larger than the OpenWA server accepts (BODY_SIZE_LIMIT / MEDIA_DOWNLOAD_MAX_BYTES): {detail}

pacing_limited.message: The daily send limit of this session is reached. Retry in {retry_after} seconds.

rate_limited.message: OpenWA is rate limiting requests. Try again shortly.

no_message.message: Provide a message, a title or media.

invalid_target.message: Target {target} is not a phone number, chat id or group:<name>.

international_format_required.message: Target {target} must be in international format, without a leading 0 (for example 972501234567).

group_ambiguous.message: More than one group is named {name}; use its id instead: {ids}

text_too_long.message: The text is {length} characters; the limit is {limit}.

caption_too_long.message: The caption is {length} characters; the limit is {limit}.

path_not_allowed.message: Media path {path} is not allowed. Add its directory to allowlist_external_dirs in configuration.yaml.

media_unreadable.message: Media file {path} cannot be read by Home Assistant.

media_too_large.message: Media file {path} is larger than {limit} MiB.

entry_not_loaded.message: OpenWA config entry {entry_id} is not loaded.

no_loaded_entries.message: No OpenWA config entry is loaded.

config_entry_required.message: More than one OpenWA entry is loaded; select one with config_entry_id.

send_message.name: Send WhatsApp message
send_message.description: Sends a text, image, video, audio or document message through OpenWA.

config_entry_id.name: OpenWA session
config_entry_id.description: Entry to send from. Required when more than one is configured.

target.name: Target
target.description: Phone numbers in international format, chat ids (…@c.us, …@g.us, …@lid) or group:<name>.

title.name: Title
title.description: Shown in bold on the first line.

message.name: Message
message.description: Message text, or the caption when media is sent.

media.name: Media
media.description: Absolute path to a file on the Home Assistant host inside allowlist_external_dirs.

media_type.name: Media type
media_type.description: Overrides the type detected from the file.

as_voice.name: Send as voice note
as_voice.description: Audio only. Sends the audio as a voice note.
